title: MINING READY! Copi Cafe Episode 63 | Cornucopias
description:
Strap on your mining helmets and prepare for the newest episode – MINING READY! 

Welcome to Copi Cafe Episode 63, where we're about to unearth pure gold. Josh & Rob take the plunge into the depths of the Launcher update and pull back the curtain on an eagerly awaited NEW RELEASE that's ready to challenge the tester's night vision.

As if that's not  enough, they excavate the scoop on the upcoming conferences. But wait, there's more – the much-awaited Leak of the Week surfaces, paving the way for a treasure trove of Community Questions.

00:00 Intro
02:53 Launcher Update 
06:34 New Release
11:27 Conferences
12:31 Leak!
14:25  Community Questions

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/cornucopiasgame
